title: pretty BRIAR|Plus Size Chiffon A-Line 3/4 Sleeves Asymmetrical Hem Wedding Guest Dress
descriptionHtml:
Make a statement at your next wedding invitation with this exquisite Plus Size Chiffon A-Line Dress. The flowing chiffon fabric and 3/4 sleeves create a regal silhouette, while the asymmetrical hem adds a touch of modern sophistication. Whether you're attending a beachside wedding or a glamorous ballroom affair, this dress is specifically designed for plus-size women who want to feel confident and beautiful on this special occasion.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Midi length.


Sleeve Style: 3/4 sleeves.


Closure: It is concealed a zipper up the back.


Undergarments: It is padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises chiffon.


Stretch: Fabric is low stretch.
